# temps_project_analytics_settings (Resource)

Which kinds of unwanted traffic a project's analytics leaves out of every report.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are.

Import with `<project_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `analytics:read`, `analytics:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_analytics_settings" "web" {
  project_id                 = temps_project.web.id
  exclude_datacenter_traffic = true
  exclude_spam_referrers     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `exclude_datacenter_traffic` (Boolean) Leave out visits from hosting and cloud networks. Needs an ASN database on the instance (`datacenter_detection_available`).
- `exclude_spam_referrers` (Boolean) Leave out visits whose referrer is on Temps' referrer-spam list.

### Read-Only

- `datacenter_detection_available` (Boolean) Whether the instance can tell datacenter traffic apart.
- `id` (String) Import ID, `<project_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>
terraform import temps_project_analytics_settings.web 8
```
